evidence.detail: Only occurrence is a footer string in discordbot/commands/modobug.py:43 telling users to use the MTGO command — no handler code found
PDBot is an external service at pdbot.pennydreadfulmagic.com; this repo imports its match logs but doesn't host its command logic
on_message_create handler only calls respond_to_card_names — no prefix command dispatch for !stillbugged exists in the Discord bot

triage.notes: The !stillbugged and !notbugged commands are processed by the PDBot MTGO bot (pdbot.pennydreadfulmagic.com), which is a separate codebase not in this repository. Cannot trace the card-name matching logic or the 'I couldn't find a bug for this card' error message. If the bug is in card-name normalization, the relevant code would be in the PDBot project.
